name: conceptcards-monorepo
description: ConceptCards - Collaborative flashcard platform with duplicate prevention, hierarchical organization, and automated spaced repetition scheduling

scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist') && !fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.cpSync('dist', 'client/dist', {recursive:true}); } else if(fs.existsSync('client/dist') && !fs.existsSync('dist')) { fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); }"
